subject: Marketing Management
notes: Marketing core. No numerical questions apply; extra objective and case items included.

questions.text: The process of creating communicating and delivering value to customers is called
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Marketing is the activity of creating communicating delivering and exchanging offerings of value.

questions.text: The marketing concept holds that the firm should focus on
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: The marketing concept centres the firm on satisfying customer needs profitably.

questions.text: The set of controllable marketing variables the firm combines is called the marketing
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: The marketing mix combines product price place and promotion.

questions.text: The selling concept focuses on aggressive promotion rather than customer satisfaction
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: The selling concept pushes products regardless of whether they fully satisfy needs.

questions.text: List the four Ps of the marketing mix
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: These four controllable variables form the core marketing mix.

questions.text: Explain the marketing environment and its components
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: The marketing environment has a microenvironment of suppliers customers and competitors and a macroenvironment of demographic economic political technological and cultural forces that the firm cannot control.
questions.explanation: Distinguish the micro and macro environments with examples.

questions.text: The stage of the buyer decision process in which the consumer recognises a gap is
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: The process begins when the buyer recognises an unmet need.

questions.text: Consumers who buy products for the first time after information gathering are called
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: New buyers enter a product category after evaluating information.

questions.text: The feeling of discomfort after a purchase that makes the buyer question the decision is called
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Post purchase dissonance is doubt about whether the right choice was made.

questions.text: Cultural and social factors influence consumer buying behaviour
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Culture social class family and reference groups shape what and how consumers buy.

questions.text: List the stages of the consumer decision process
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: Need recognition information search evaluation of alternatives purchase decision and post purchase behaviour.
questions.explanation: These five stages describe how consumers reach buying decisions.

questions.text: Explain the factors influencing consumer behaviour
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: Consumer behaviour is shaped by cultural social personal and psychological factors such as culture family age occupation motivation perception and attitudes.
questions.explanation: Cover each category of influence with examples.

questions.text: Dividing a market into distinct groups of buyers with different needs is called
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Segmentation divides a heterogeneous market into homogeneous buyer groups.

questions.text: Segmentation based on age income and occupation is called
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Demographic segmentation uses measurable population characteristics.

questions.text: A firm that ignores segment differences and offers one offer to the whole market uses undifferentiated marketing
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Undifferentiated marketing treats the whole market as one segment.

questions.text: Distinguish between market segmentation and targeting
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: Segmentation divides the market into groups while targeting selects which group or groups the firm will serve.
questions.explanation: Segmentation precedes the choice of target segments.

questions.text: Explain the bases of market segmentation
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: Markets are segmented on geographic demographic psychographic and behavioural bases. Each divides buyers by location personal traits lifestyles or usage behaviour.
questions.explanation: Describe each base with examples of the variables used.

questions.text: The product element that distinguishes one brand from another is its
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: A brand is a name term symbol or design that identifies a seller.

questions.text: The pricing method that adds a fixed margin to the cost of the product is
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Cost plus pricing adds a standard markup to the unit cost.

questions.text: A channel of distribution with no intermediaries between producer and consumer is direct
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: A direct channel sells straight from producer to consumer.

questions.text: List the stages of the product life cycle
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Sales and profits follow a predictable path through these four stages.

questions.text: Explain the factors to consider when setting a price
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: Pricing considers costs demand competition and marketing objectives. Costs set the floor demand sets the ceiling and competitors prices anchor the range.
questions.explanation: Cover internal cost objectives and external demand and competition.

questions.text: The process of gathering analysing and reporting marketing information is
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Marketing research systematically gathers and analyses data for marketing decisions.

questions.text: Data collected first hand for a specific research problem is called
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Primary data is original data collected for the current purpose.

questions.text: A sample is a subset of the population selected for study
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Sampling studies a representative subset to draw conclusions about the whole.

questions.text: Distinguish between primary and secondary data
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: Primary data is collected fresh for the study while secondary data already exists having been collected earlier for another purpose.
questions.explanation: The difference lies in the origin and purpose of the data.

questions.text: Explain the steps in the marketing research process
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: Research proceeds from defining the problem through developing the plan collecting data analysing data and presenting findings to decision makers.
questions.explanation: Trace each step from problem definition to report.

questions.text: Marketing of intangible activities rather than physical goods is called
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Services marketing deals with intangible offerings like banking travel and healthcare.

questions.text: The characteristic of services meaning they cannot be stored is
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Perishability means services cannot be inventoried for later sale.

questions.text: The characteristics of services include intangibility inseparability variability and perishability
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: These four characteristics distinguish services from goods.

questions.text: List the characteristics of services
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: These four features shape services marketing strategy.

questions.text: Explain the recent trends in marketing
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: Recent trends include digital and social media marketing influencer marketing personalisation green marketing and data driven marketing. Technology and customer expectations are reshaping strategy.
questions.explanation: Cover digitalisation personalisation and sustainability trends.

questions.text: Assertion: Market segmentation enables a firm to serve customers more effectively. Reason: Different segments have different needs that require tailored offerings
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.topic: Market segmentation targeting and positioning (assertion reason)
options: Both assertion and reason are true and reason explains assertion
Both are true but reason does not explain assertion
Assertion is true but reason is false
Assertion is false but reason is true
questions.explanation: Tailoring offerings to distinct needs is exactly how segmentation improves effectiveness.

questions.text: Match the mix element to its activity
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Place concerns distribution while promotion concerns communication.

questions.text: The added value that a brand gives a product beyond its functional benefits is
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Brand equity is the extra value a strong brand adds to the product.

questions.text: A pricing strategy that sets a high initial price to skim maximum revenue from early buyers is
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Skimming targets less price sensitive early adopters with a high launch price.

questions.text: Setting a low initial price to gain market share quickly is called penetration pricing
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Penetration pricing uses a low price to attract many buyers and capture share.

questions.text: Explain the concept of the product life cycle and its marketing implications
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: The product life cycle traces sales from introduction through growth and maturity to decline and each stage needs a different marketing strategy.
questions.explanation: Strategy shifts as the product moves through its life stages.

questions.text: Read the case: A new organic juice brand wants to launch but is unsure which segment to target. Suggest segmentation bases and a positioning approach
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: Segment by demographic health conscious and psychographic lifestyle variables. Position the juice as a premium natural and healthy choice distinct from sugary drinks.
questions.explanation: Apply segmentation bases and craft a clear positioning statement.

questions.text: Read the case: A retailer notices falling sales of a mature product line and rising customer complaints about features. Identify the life cycle stage and recommend a marketing response
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: The product is in maturity moving toward decline. The retailer should modify the product repackage or reposition it and adjust promotion to revive demand.
questions.explanation: Diagnose the stage and propose product and promotion modifications.

questions.text: Which of the following is a non controllable element of the marketing environment
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Competitors are part of the external environment outside the firms control.

questions.text: The philosophy that the best way to satisfy customers is through continuous quality improvement is called
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: TQM makes quality a central part of delivering customer value.

questions.text: Relationship marketing focuses on building long term relationships with customers rather than single transactions
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: Relationship marketing aims to retain customers and build loyalty.

questions.text: Explain the difference between marketing and selling
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: Selling focuses on the needs of the seller and pushing the product while marketing focuses on customer needs and creating value.
questions.explanation: Marketing is customer centred while selling is product centred.

questions.text: Explain the importance of branding to a marketer
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: Branding differentiates the product builds customer loyalty commands premium prices and simplifies the buyers choice. A strong brand is a durable competitive asset.
questions.explanation: Cover differentiation loyalty pricing power and ease of choice.

questions.text: Describe the methods of sales promotion
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: Sales promotion includes consumer tools like samples coupons and contests and trade tools like dealer discounts and allowances that stimulate short term buying.
questions.explanation: Distinguish consumer oriented and trade oriented promotion tools.

questions.text: A market where buyers outnumber sellers and prices are set by supply and demand is a competitive market
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.explanation: In competitive markets no single buyer or seller controls the price.

questions.text: Explain the role of marketing information systems in decision making
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: A marketing information system collects stores and analyses internal and external data and supplies managers with timely information for planning control and decisions.
questions.explanation: Cover the components and how MIS supports decisions.

questions.text: List any four functions of marketing
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: Buying selling transportation storage financing and risk bearing.
questions.explanation: These exchange and physical distribution functions move goods to consumers.

questions.text: Explain the advantages and disadvantages of advertising
questions.subject: Marketing Management
questions.correctAnswer: Advertising reaches a mass audience builds awareness and brand image economically. Its drawbacks are high total cost impersonal nature and difficulty measuring direct effect on sales.
questions.explanation: Balance reach and image building against cost and measurability.
